extract_mc_mesh: extract a marching cubes mesh from a trained NSVF model checkpoint and save as a PLY file
extract_voxel_centers: extract voxel center points from a trained NSVF model and write them to a PLY file
extract_voxel_mesh: extract a voxel mesh representation from a trained NSVF model and save as a PLY file
run_extract_cli: run the extract CLI tool with --path and --output flags to export geometry from a trained model
review_main: review the main function that loads a model ensemble and exports surfaces or voxels to PLY format
